events.title: Acadia Healthcare Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Rising Patient Days
events.body: ACHC Q1 tops estimates with 37 cents EPS and 7.6% revenue growth, driven by higher patient days and admissions despite shorter stays and rising costs.

events.title: Select Medical Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates on Higher Expenses
events.body: SEM's Q1 EPS misses due to higher expenses and weaker patient days, even as revenues top estimates and rehab segment growth partly offsets pressure.

events.title: UnitedHealth Pops 14.5% After Q1 Beat: Still a Buy or Too Late Now?
events.body: UNH surges 14.5% after a Q1 earnings beat and raised 2026 outlook, but membership declines, DOJ probes and valuation concerns could cap the rally.

events.title: Humana Beats Q1 Earnings Estimates on Increasing Premiums
events.body: HUM posts Q1 earnings beat as premiums surge and membership grows, but rising costs and benefit ratio pressure weigh on profit.
